native.adaptationLimits: Preserve native dp/sp, Compose semantic roles and native state behavior. No HTML/CSS previews, synthesized tonal ramps or web CSS detector on Kotlin: they would not reproduce native typography, focus, wallpaper roles or elevation.
native.defaultOwnership: Theme.kt explicitly defines all 15 Inter Material type roles, paired schemes, atmosphere and shapes. Material supplies component interactions, motion, control state glyphs and overlay elevation. Wallpaper affects supporting roles only.
native.evidenceLimits: current Theme, AppIcons, VisualSystem, PersonalOsApp, TodayScreen, MoneyOverview, MoneyScreen and MoneyEditors Kotlin sources; approved reference, direction and user brief. Directly inspected final physical Samsung SM-S942B captures: [Money light](screenshots/phase-1.6/money-overview-light.png), [Today dark](screenshots/phase-1.6/today-personal-dark.png) and [Money at app-local 1.5x text scale](screenshots/phase-1.6/large-text-money.png). These confirm compact controls, grouped monthly comparison, quiet panels, outline navigation, readable dark bars and the large-text wrapping/labeled Quick Add path. Phone settings were not changed. The [Phase 1.6 handover](phase-1.6-handover.md) records the full physical capture set, build/lint gates, JVM/device results and measured cold startup; [independent review](design/phase-1.6-review.md) records the bounded rendered inspection. Captures include retained disposable regression records, not product seed content. No 2x text, tablet/foldable, arbitrary wallpaper contrast, TalkBack, RTL or general performance certification is made. The app bundles the licensed font and native vector paths; reference and captures remain documentation evidence, not shipping raster assets. Browser CSS detection and HTML/CSS component replicas are inapplicable to this native system.
native.notCanonized: the pre-existing `Foundation screen` eyebrow is a craft-floor defect, not a reusable label style; it is outside this documentation-only edit. Debug/sample disclosures remain local status. No hard offset shadow or glyph-icon convention is established. The context loader's legacy PRODUCT.md schema drift remains outside the requested design-record refresh; `init` owns that separate repair.
native.provenance: User-pinned Phase 1.5 sky-blue world with explicitly authorized Phase 1.6 refinement; same native Compose direction, no new world, generated comp or iOS replication. Font provenance: docs/design/fonts/README.md; icon provenance: docs/design/icon-provenance.md. OFL and ISC/Feather notices are packaged as APK raw resources.

typographyImplementation.instantiation: One unmodified variable face, explicit weight instances 400/500/600 at optical size 14sp; system glyph fallback.
typographyImplementation.financialFeatures: Display, headline and title roles enable tnum; body and label roles do not.

iconImplementation.construction: 23 native Lucide outline vectors, 24-unit grid, rounded caps/joins, uniform 1.75-unit stroke. Back and book auto-mirror; RTL unverified.
iconImplementation.dependencyPolicy: Local vectors without runtime icon library, icon font or extended Material icon dependency; checkbox/radio/switch state glyphs remain Material.

native.systemBarPolicy: Only the focused Activity/Dialog window applies contrast; theme/focus updates post after native focus dispatch to avoid another window restoring stale bar styles.

layoutBehavior.compactNavigation: 72dp content plus system gesture insets; 22dp destination vectors; central 48dp circular Quick Add with 24dp vector. Above fontScale 1.3, separate labeled Quick Add above 80dp navigation content.
layoutBehavior.monthlyComparison: Period selector and actual spending/income share one panel; FlowRow horizontal/vertical gaps 24dp/12dp with minimum spending/income column widths 140dp/110dp.
layoutBehavior.touchTargets: Money actions and choices retain at least 48dp height; 36dp decorative icon badge is not an interactive target.
layoutBehavior.moneyTabs: PrimaryScrollableTabRow, native underline, no divider, transparent container, edgePadding 0dp, minimum tab width 64dp.

narrative.northStar: A clear day for your priorities and your money
narrative.overview:
The approved [sky-blue direction and Phase 1.6 refinement](design/phase-1.5-direction.md) retain a sky-to-mist atmosphere, softly layered panels and clear financial figures. The user-selected [finance reference](design/references/finance-ui-direction.png) supplies the material character; native Android components supply navigation and interaction. Phase 1.6 tightens the same world through bundled Inter, one outline icon family and quieter controls.

The implementation uses opaque tonal panels, translucent borders and restrained native elevation to suggest frost without backdrop blur. Today keeps priorities ahead of a compact budget and domain summaries. Money gives currency-specific balances a stronger hierarchy, then quick actions, selected-month summaries and ledger detail. [PRODUCT.md](PRODUCT.md) points to durable product authority; the product name remains provisional.
keyCharacteristics: Sky-blue light atmosphere and a deliberate deep-navy night scheme.
Opaque rounded panels, fine borders and restrained native shadows.
Bundled Inter across the complete Material role scale, with tabular financial figures.
One locally bundled Lucide outline family across app surfaces.
Native actions, adaptive navigation and practical scrolling editors.

rules.name: The Stable Sky Rule
rules.body: Wallpaper personalization affects supporting Material roles; preserve the brand-blue primary and atmosphere palette.

rules.name: The Semantic Pair Rule
rules.body: Consume Material and atmosphere roles with matching content colors; static swatches are source evidence rather than screen-level literals.

rules.name: The Financial Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Reserve displaySmall for the balance header; retain currency and explicit financial meaning beside supporting figures.

rules.name: The Tonal Frost Rule
rules.body: Keep elevated panels opaque; create frost through tone, border and restrained native elevation.

dos: **Do** preserve stable blue branding and semantic Material/atmosphere roles.
**Do** use opaque bordered panels over the shared gradient with native elevation.
**Do** use the bundled Inter Material role scale, tabular financial figures and currency labels.
**Do** use the shared Lucide outline vectors and retain native Material control state glyphs.
**Do** preserve native insets, wrapping, scrollable forms and explicit status text.
donts: **Don't** replace native navigation, Back or vector icons with copied iOS chrome or glyphs.
**Don't** apply runtime backdrop blur or translucent fills to shared elevated panels.
**Don't** invent trends, combine currencies or present forecasts as recorded spending.
**Don't** imply deferred non-Money workflows save records.
